subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the conflicting fork PR, or open a focused target-repo replacement for this source-proven reminder guard fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only exact closing implementation candidate is outside the target repository and conflicts with current main, so routing should avoid duplicate automation without maintainer intent.

options.title: Open Focused Replacement
options.body: Use the fork PR as source material but land a clean target-repo PR with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to refresh that branch into a mergeable target-repo path before review.

options.title: Defer Behind Broader Reminder Work
options.body: Keep this issue open while accepting the current isolated-cron false positive until a broader reminder-guard cleanup is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Open Focused Replacement
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source material but land a clean target-repo PR with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame for the affected helper and compaction state files points to their recent refactor, making them the strongest current-code routing owner for the adopt-or-replace choice.
